fid_signals: Official Track1 uses FID against a reference artistic image set; public EmoArt distribution is the strongest legal proxy for style-family coverage.
Top public Track1 rows have AAS near 0.99 and FID around 66-67; our gap is mostly FID/distribution, not AAS alone.
Local fid_like has already anti-correlated on two own anchors, so use it only as one feature in an ensemble.
aas_signals: Official AAS has content/style/attribute alignment; captions must preserve supports/surfaces such as scroll, poster, silk, typography when explicitly requested.
FAB-G salience suggests attribute cues should be selected, not blindly over-stuffed.
EmoVIT affective reasoning suggests judges may value visual evidence for emotion, not only object naming.
crawler_limits: Public crawl cannot reveal hidden FID reference images, full AAS judge prompts, exact multimodal model, or hidden inference settings.
Any private test data or labels must remain private and must not be redistributed or used outside challenge participation.
